bio: Served à la carte or as a set menu, classic cuisine made with seasonal produce is the order of the day here. The upscale interior is very comfortable, with harmonious, lovingly arranged decorative objects – it certainly does full justice to the luxurious setting of the traditional holiday hotel of the same name in which this restaurant is housed. For overnight stays, there are elegant country-house-style guestrooms – this is after all the sister hotel of Baiersbronn's Hotel Bareiss. Make a beeline for the gorgeous garden terrace in summer. A must in the afternoon: cakes made to Hermine Bareiss's old recipes!...
